title: Evaluate serial runner profile — evidence does not support adoption
hypothesis: Serial file execution might reduce latency for the two pinned score fixtures. This retrospective hypothesis is not supported by the Phase 8 observations.
change: Consider the serial profile only if scoped latency improves by at least 1 ms without quality regression. No patch is included or authorized.
risks: Six local runs cannot establish general Harness performance, causality or model superiority. Cost and human effort are unknown.
rollback: Keep the current runner and both profiles unchanged; any future approved patch must retain a separately reviewed rollback.
